# LR: generated by tools/medieval_arts/lr_ma_port.py from Medieval Arts (dates +5000; MA builds after 476 become slots). Edit the tool, not this file.
MA_add_monument = {
	title:$TITLE$.title_province = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_special_district_slot = no
					has_game_rule = MA_monuments_all
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { game_start_date >= $DATE$.1.1 }
				add_special_district = $MONUMENT$_district
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_special_district_slot = no }
				add_special_district_slot = $MONUMENT$_district
			}
			else = {
				add_special_district = $MONUMENT$_district
				remove_district_type = $MONUMENT$_district
			}
		}
	}
}

MA_add_monument_two_levels = {
	if = {
		limit = { game_start_date >= $UPGRADE_DATE$.1.1 }
		title:$TITLE$.title_province = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					#NOTE: to avoid error.log should you place a has_special_district = no here?
					OR = {
						has_special_district_slot = no
						has_game_rule = MA_monuments_all
					}
				}
				add_special_district = $MONUMENT$_district
				special_district = { add_building = $UPGRADE$ }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		MA_add_monument = { DATE = $DATE$ TITLE = $TITLE$ MONUMENT = $MONUMENT$ }
	}
}

MA_replace_monument = {
	title:$TITLE$.title_province = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_game_rule = MA_monuments_all }
			remove_district_type = $REPLACE$
			if = {
				limit = { game_start_date >= $DATE$.1.1 }
				add_special_district = $MONUMENT$_district
			}
			else = {
				add_special_district = $MONUMENT$_district
				remove_district_type = $MONUMENT$_district
			}
		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { has_game_rule = MA_ahistorical_monuments_yes }

	}

	#Others
	title:b_pataliputra.title_province = {
		remove_district_type = nalanda_university_district
		add_special_district = MA_ashoka_palace1_district
	}
	title:b_rajagrha.title_province = {
		add_special_district = nalanda_university_district
	}

		limit = { title:b_ostia.title_province = { NOT = { has_building_or_higher = pam_lateran_basilica_01 } } }
		MA_add_monument = { DATE = 5300 TITLE = b_ostia MONUMENT = pam_lateran_basilica_01 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { title:b_praha.title_province = { has_building_or_higher = MA_prague_castle1 } }
		MA_add_monument = { DATE = 9999 TITLE = b_beroun MONUMENT = generic_university }
	}
